positive_prompt: Elegant, sophisticated event programme for an Awards Ceremony. Dark black background with a subtle, shimmering gold foil texture. The title 'Annual Excellence Awards' is prominently displayed in a classic, elegant serif font with a raised gold effect. The programme content area utilizes a luxurious, textured paper effect, with a restrained gold accent. The overall atmosphere is one of prestige and celebration, evoking a sense of timeless quality. The composition is balanced and formal, with ample negative space to create a premium feel. Lighting is soft and warm, enhancing the gold tones.
negative_prompt: Rough, chaotic, modern, minimalist, cluttered, low resolution, gradients, cartoonish, childish
short_design_rationale: A classic, luxurious design reflecting the premium nature of the event. The colour palette and textures create a sense of sophistication and celebration, while the typography reinforces the event's prestigious title.
